color.$description: Fireside's orb glows in its peach copper, the primary color.

light.$description: The brightest light inside the orb.

glow.$description: The glow nearest the orb, and its farthest bloom.

shade.$description: The deepest color, at the top of the glass.

plain.$description: The light on a plain page (the theme's own page color behind it). Fireside's light on a plain page is warm white, its lightest peach: a warm bulb next to a white one, never yellow (Sharon).

plain-far.$description: Where the light on a plain page fades out, it warms to this: white near the orb, peach farther away, like a lantern's glow on a wall. Fireside's second-lightest peach, so it's warm, never orange or yellow (Sharon).
